title: AV-EMO-REASONING: BENCHMARKING EMOTIONAL REASONING CAPABILITIES IN OMNI-MODAL LLMS WITH AUDIO-VISUAL CUES
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking emotional reasoning in omni-modal LLMs using audio-visual cues (e.g., happiness, anger, sadness, arousal, valence). It does not evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
